text: This report includes several detailed appendices that provide a full financial summary of all program areas of Exhibition Place for the third quarter, ending September 30, 2023.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (November 20, 2023) from the Chief Financial Officer, Exhibition Place for information. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 20, 2023) from the Chief Financial Officer, Exhibition Place remain confidential as it contains financial information that belongs to the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place and has monetary value or potential monetary value.
